messages.content: Ensure each word in your response has at least one consonant cluster (two or more consonants together). Does power law scaling in neural networks imply that there must be an exponential increase in the size of training dataset to get modest performance improvements?

message.content: No. Nonlinear scaling does not necessitate exponential data growth. Modest gains often demand substantial extra examples, yet strict exponentiality remains unproven. Many models exhibit sub-exponential trends. Thus, the premise fails.
